title: Fujino scores twice as Man City win 4-1 in Italy
lead: After three draws, Manchester City have finally won a match in the Women's Champions League, with a 4-1 victory against Inter Milan.
body: On Tuesday 10 November 2026, Manchester City Women played Inter Milan in the Women's Champions League. Before this game, City had drawn their first 3 matches in the competition, so they really needed a win.

It started badly for the English team. Elisa Bartoli scored for Inter after 24 minutes. But Aoba Fujino replied with a goal in the 33rd minute, and she scored again just before half-time. 2-1 to City!

In the second half, City kept attacking. Kerstin Casparij, the captain on the night, made it 3-1, and Grace Clinton scored a fourth goal after a cross from Lauren Hemp. City had 21 shots in the match.

Thanks to this first win, City have climbed to 7th place. On the same evening, another English team, Chelsea, were frustrated: they drew 0-0 in Sweden against BK Häcken, but they are still 3rd in the table.

title: England beat the world champions in Madrid!
lead: With only 10 players at the end, England have beaten Spain 3-2 and finished top of their Nations League group.
body: On Sunday 15 November 2026, England played Spain in Madrid in the Nations League. Spain are the world champions, and they had not lost a match for more than 40 games. But England won 3-2!

Just before half-time, Harry Kane scored a penalty. After the break, Ezri Konsa scored with a header from a Declan Rice corner, and 4 minutes later Ben White made it 3-0. What a start to the second half!

Then things changed. Elliot Anderson got a red card for a foul on Lamine Yamal, so England had only 10 players. Mikel Oyarzabal scored a penalty for Spain, and later Nico Williams made it 3-2. Spain attacked again and again, but goalkeeper James Trafford made 6 saves and England held on.
Both teams have 15 points, but England have finished first in the group because their goal difference is better. Their coach, Thomas Tuchel, said it was "a statement victory".
